# Results summary (generated by `python -m ml.src.train`)

> Models were trained and evaluated on simulated navigation data. Results show the ability to recognise the simulated patterns, not real-world spoofing detection performance.

Seed 42; 400 simulated trajectories; split by trajectory: train 240, val 80, test 80

## Feature set: position

| model | kind | precision | recall | F1 | accuracy | PR-AUC | FPR |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| logistic_regression | supervised | 0.786 | 0.214 | 0.336 | 0.807 | 0.452 | 0.017 |
| decision_tree | supervised | 0.731 | 0.257 | 0.381 | 0.809 | 0.478 | 0.028 |
| random_forest | supervised | 0.655 | 0.273 | 0.386 | 0.801 | 0.508 | 0.043 |
| gaussian_nb | supervised | 0.695 | 0.204 | 0.315 | 0.798 | 0.355 | 0.026 |
| isolation_forest | unsupervised_anomaly | 0.266 | 0.057 | 0.094 | 0.749 | 0.327 | 0.046 |
